title: Piron's new band personnel
summary: Williams lists the players in Piron's new band after he got rid of Pete and the earlier group.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: We'll put it on the next tape. You got time for one another half hour, huh? Yeah. Then I'll take you to the other building and run on down then. Oh, back to Piran. Who played piano with him when you were with him?

Well, when I was with him, he had a new band. See, he had got rid of Pete and all of that bunch. See, he had me, Eddie Pearson, Joe Phillips, Leo Dejon, Elliot Taylor, and Arthur Dudley, and Alavretta, Alexandra of piano. Oh, yeah. Sales, and Simon. See, that was his new band, you see.
